name: Itazura Katei Kyoushi
source:
"Unbelievable! That a girl your age does such a thing!!"

A perverse home teacher watches his very young student masturbate, uses his power to teach a "lesson".

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ098815.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“真不敢相信！你这么小就做这种事！！”

心术不正的家庭教师看着年幼的女学生自慰，便滥用自己的权力，要给她上所谓的“一课”。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ098815.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
